The desk combines AI signals with manual control. Newcomers can start on the practice account, fund US$200 when ready, and trade 11 assets through the partner broker.
We do not trade on the platforms we review and we take no referral position in the verdict. We read the pages, verify what is verifiable, and score what remains.
whatItClaims: A free demo account with practice funds.
Around-the-clock support through the partner desk.
Signals generated without manual chart reading.
A US$200 minimum deposit to start.
Free registration, with account activation by confirmation link.
whatWeChecked: The performance story: no verified track record behind the return claims.
The number reuse: one score figure doing more than one job.
The deposit terms: minimum amount, payment methods and where the money sits.
The demo claim: practice account confirmed in the signup flow.
The payout promise: within-a-day wording without processing detail.
The broker relationship: which partner desk executes orders.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Create the account with your contact details, then verify it through the emailed link.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Fund the account with US$200 - bank cards, transfer, PayPal and Skrill are accepted.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Set your preferences, select automatic or manual execution, and run the practice account first.

pros: No platform fees on top of spreads.
cons: Performance examples without dates or proof.
Asset list that shifts between pages.
The headline fee claim and the real cost disagree.
Two conflicting support figures.
redFlags: No regulator, licence or audit named anywhere.
Marketing numbers the fine print quietly qualifies.
A support bullet that garbles two claims at once.

faqs.a: The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.
The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.

faqs.q: Is Ethera safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.
Yes - signup is free and activates through a confirmation link. The first cost is the US$200 deposit, which stays in your trading balance.
11 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

bottomLine: Ethera is a standard-issue AI trading desk with the usual strengths and the usual omissions. None of the omissions are dealbreakers - they are conditions.
Our 4.5 reflects what the pages publish and what they skip. It is not a warning off - it is a reminder to trade the product, not the pitch.
